meta.rule_policy: Advice can only reduce or shift the ration, never raise it above the feeding table baseline. Missing or stale data never raises the ration.

rules.name: Cloudy Weather Sunlight Depression
rules.reason: Reduced sunlight suppresses phytoplankton photosynthesis, impairing morning oxygen generation.

rules.name: Thermal Stress Ration Reduction
rules.reason: Water temperature exceeds species optimum; digestion efficiency declines and biological oxygen demand spikes.

rules.name: Cold Water Metabolic Reduction
rules.reason: Cold water suppresses fish enzymatic metabolic rate; unconsumed feed decomposes and pollutes pond water.

rules.name: Stale Telemetry Precautionary Reduction
rules.reason: Sensor readings are stale or missing; precautionary reduction applied to prevent undetected hypoxia mortalities.

rules.name: Elevated Ammonia Water Quality Emergency
rules.reason: Elevated toxic un-ionized ammonia detected; feeding creates organic waste load and must be curtailed.
